I told Pree in her #central-team thread that the settled seat count for the Marrow Fieldworks 2026 renewal is 87.

I couldn't find any Marrow Fieldworks account files, so Hollis's correction is the only source for 87. I also told her to ignore the old 268 entry, which is still in the brain because I couldn't retire it.
